maintainedBy: hand — every figure typed by a human; `npm run measure:api-surface` reports the measured surface beside it, and docs/intents/api-surface-floor-has-no-basis tracks replacing these
description: Per-plugin API-surface coverage. Counts are MEASURED by scripts/measure-api-surface.mts and published as upper bounds; this file holds only what a measurement cannot produce — the prose description of each surface and the outOfScope judgements with their reasons.
method: scripts/audit-api-surface.ts runs the measurement and renders benchmark-results/api-surface-coverage.md. No count in this file; audit rejects one.

plugins.surface: NestJS — Controllers, Providers, Guards, Decorators, Pipes
plugins.denominatorNote: 374 callables is the whole framework, including every decorator, utility and error class.
plugins.notes: 63% is at the floor. NestJS coverage is the lightest of the security plugins (6 rules). High-value expansion targets: ExceptionFilter patterns and Microservices transport-layer security.

plugins.surface: Node.js core modules — fs, child_process, crypto, vm, dns, http(s)
plugins.denominatorNote: Node core module exports ARE the consumer-callable surface — fs, child_process, crypto, vm, dns, http(s) on node@24, constructors and _-prefixed internals removed. 199 is the denominator this repo already argued for in docs/intents/api-surface-floor-has-no-basis.
plugins.notes: The gap is real product debt, not a denominator artefact: createPrivateKey, createPublicKey, createSecretKey, createECDH, createDiffieHellman, diffieHellman and checkPrime are named nowhere, in a plugin whose stated surface includes crypto.

plugins.denominatorNote: 111 callables enumerates the whole SDK including error classes and pagination helpers.

plugins.surface: node-postgres — pg.Client / pg.Pool / pg.Query callable surface
plugins.denominatorNote: Walks pg prototypes and picks up wire-protocol internals (handleDataRow, sendCopyFromChunk, attachListeners) that no consumer calls.
plugins.notes: Complete coverage of the query-construction surface: all 13 in-scope APIs have at least one rule. The 14th public API, type-parser registration, is a result-coercion hook rather than a statement-construction sink and is excluded from the denominator with a written reason.
